editorial.blurb: Qiao Lin brings authentic, deeply flavorful hotpot to downtown Chicago with an impressive selection of fresh ingredients and customizable broths that make every visit feel like a special occasion.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation ahead of time—the restaurant is deceptively large inside but fills up quickly. If you're visiting Friday or Saturday after 9:30 PM, you'll get 31% off all items.
